Six families: Modality (text, multimodal, image, video, audio, voice, embeddings), Channel (model developers, cloud marketplaces, inference platforms, neoclouds), Tier (flagship, core, compact), Lic

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description:
Weekly history. With index_code: the index series (benchmark level, May 2026 = 100, and the spot price with its 25th and 75th percentiles) for up to 260 weeks; free. With model_name: every vendor's price for that model week by week, showing when each SKU was repriced; Attic Standard MCP PRO.

tools.description:
The nine market KPIs Attic Standard publishes each week.
- Price structure: output premium, caching discount, caching availability
- Price dynamics: repricing activity, repricing depth, post-launch drift
- Competition: multi-vendor spread, first-party premium, marketplace premium

Each KPI returns i

tools.name: get_model_intelligence
tools.description: Six capability and coverage measures drawn from the metadata behind every tracked model: reasoning tier share, long-context saturation, frontier context ceiling, output ceiling spread, training cutoff lag and vendor modality breadth. Read alongside the market KPIs, they explain why models are priced

tools.name: get_index_constituents
tools.description:
What sits inside an index basket this week. Free tier: the composition (SKUs, models and vendors, split by channel, origin, tier and license). Attic Standard MCP PRO: the model-by-model basket with the vendors selling each model.

Examples:
  - "What is in the flagship index?" -> index_code="FLG"

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Coverage of the tracked market (vendors and pricing services, in total, by channel and in published indexes; countries, models, priced SKUs, published indexes) and price distributions split by modality, unit and direction. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: Every pricing service in the Attic Standard fleet, with its vendor (the company, in parent), channel (model developer, cloud marketplace, inference platform or neocloud), country, region, currency and pricing page. Returns the vendor and pricing-service totals. Filter by channel, region or country.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search every priced SKU by modality, vendor, channel, creator, family, tier, license, origin, reasoning, open weights, direction, maximum price and minimum context window. Cheapest first. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard

tools.name: get_model_detail
tools.description: One model in depth: specs (creator, origin, tier, license, context window, output limit, training cutoff, modalities), the Attic Standard indexes it belongs to, and its price at every vendor. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstan

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: The same model, or a whole family, priced across every vendor that sells it: cheapest and highest offer, vendor count and spread ratio for each direction, plus each offer with its channel. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandar

tools.name: get_vendor_catalog
tools.description: Everything one vendor sells: channel, country, pricing page, model and SKU counts, and the full price list. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_kpis · Private data: get_index_benchmarks, get_price_history, get_market_stats, search_models, compare_prices, get_vendor_catalog · Public sink: get_kpis, get_model_intelligence · Destructive: compare_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_kpis · Private data: get_index_benchmarks, get_price_history, get_market_stats, search_models, compare_prices, get_vendor_catalog · Public sink: get_kpis, get_model_intelligence · Destructive: compare_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_stats" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
